books.title: All My Rage
books.author: Sabaa Tahir
books.summary: A devastating, deeply emotional contemporary novel about two teens bound by grief, love, and generational trauma. Readers consistently praise its raw honesty and the way it balances pain with compassion and hope.

books.title: Concrete Rose
books.author: Angie Thomas
books.summary: A prequel to The Hate U Give following Maverick as he struggles with fatherhood, loyalty, and survival. Readers admire its emotional depth and refusal to simplify masculinity or redemption.

books.title: On the Come Up
books.author: Angie Thomas
books.summary: A sharp, voice-driven story about a teen rapper navigating fame, poverty, and public perception. Frequently praised for its energy, realism, and social commentary.

books.title: On the Hook
books.author: Francisco X. Stork
books.summary: A tightly paced novel about fear, violence, and moral choice as a teen is threatened by gang retaliation. Readers highlight its realism and relentless tension.

books.title: My Life as a Meme
books.author: Janet Tashjian
books.summary: A humorous, illustrated middle-grade/teen crossover full of internet culture and awkward moments. Fans enjoy its quick pacing and relatable comedy.

books.title: Here Lies Daniel Tate
books.author: Cristin Terrill
books.summary: A gripping psychological thriller about a con artist who assumes the identity of a missing boy. Readers praise its twists and moral ambiguity.

books.title: Saints of the Household
books.author: Ari Tison
books.summary: Two brothers confront the consequences of violence and inherited trauma. Widely praised for emotional intensity and cultural grounding.

books.title: Wake the Wild Creatures
books.author: Nova Ren Suma
books.summary: A haunting, atmospheric novel about memory, control, and a mysterious feminist commune. Readers enjoy its eerie tone and slow-burn mystery.

books.title: We Are Not from Here
books.author: Jenny Torres Sanchez
books.summary: A harrowing journey of three teens fleeing Guatemala toward the U.S. border. Frequently described as brutal, necessary, and unforgettable.

books.title: Running
books.author: Natalia Sylvester
books.summary: A thoughtful look at politics, family loyalty, and identity as a teen grapples with her father's presidential campaign.

books.title: This Place Is Still Beautiful
books.author: XIXI Tian
books.summary: A character-driven story about belonging and emotional vulnerability. Readers often praise its quiet realism.

books.title: Unexpected Consequence of Bleeding on a Tuesday
books.author: Kelsey B. Toney
books.summary: A powerful exploration of chronic pain, medical dismissal, and teen decision-making. Widely praised for its honesty.

books.title: The Dangerous Art of Blending In
books.author: Angelo Surmelis
books.summary: A queer coming-of-age story centered on abuse, silence, and self-expression. Readers find it intense but uplifting.

books.title: Breathe and Count Back from Ten
books.author: Natalia Sylvester
books.summary: A tender story about disability, body autonomy, and first love set in a Florida mermaid attraction.

books.title: Kings of B'more
books.author: R. Eric Thomas
books.summary: A joyful, queer road-trip story celebrating friendship, Pride, and one unforgettable day.

books.title: Wild and Crooked
books.author: Leah Thomas
books.summary: A small-town mystery focused on reputation, truth, and inherited guilt. Readers appreciate its nuance.

books.title: You've Reached Sam
books.author: Dustin Thao
books.summary: A grief-driven romance built around the idea of one last conversation. Hugely popular and emotionally divisive.

books.title: Because You'll Never Meet Me
books.author: Leah Thomas
books.summary: An epistolary friendship between two boys who can never meet. Praised for tenderness and originality.

books.title: Love Match
books.author: Priyanka Taslim
books.summary: A fake-dating rom-com shaped by family expectations and cultural pressure. Readers enjoy its charm.

books.title: The Boyfriend Wish
books.author: Swati Teerdhala
books.summary: A magical rom-com questioning whether perfection is better than authenticity.

books.title: Drawn That Way
books.author: Elissa Sussman
books.summary: A creative-industry romance about ambition, sexism, and self-worth.

books.title: 16 & Pregnant
books.author: Lala Thomas
books.summary: A grounded look at teen pregnancy and friendship under pressure.

books.title: Anne of Greenville
books.author: Mariko Tamaki
books.summary: A queer, modern reimagining of Anne of Green Gables with humor and heart.

books.title: Three Sides of a Heart
books.author: Natalie C. Parker (editor)
books.summary: A mixed anthology exploring love triangles across genres and identities.

books.title: Paris Thibideaux and the World of Lost Things
books.author: K. F. Thurber
books.summary: A gentle story about creativity, community, and making something from nothing.

books.title: This Place Is Still Beautiful
books.author: XIXI Tian
books.summary: A reflective contemporary novel about emotional connection and belonging.

books.title: Wake the Wild Creatures
books.author: Nova Ren Suma
books.summary: A haunting exploration of memory and control wrapped in mystery.
